label: L=9 copy phase, outputs 2/7/8, input j/u/s/v/e
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate coordinate (0.03% of steps). Active only in the copy phase, almost only for length-9 sequences (99% of mass), at steps 16-17 (recall_idx 7-8, the last two outputs; ~73% of mass) and step 11 (recall_idx 2; ~21%). It never fires during the original or delimiter phases or for L<=7. Within that context it prefers certain fed-back input tokens: j alone holds 57% of mass, then u, s, v, e. The largest activations are on input j at t=16/17. The predicate gets ~85% of mass on dev but precision is only ~3.5%: most L=9 late-copy steps with these inputs do not fire, and no history variable we tried (in_count, prev tokens) separated the firing cases. Even restricting to input j at recall 7-8 only raises precision to ~10%.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
